name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Elisabetta Gualmini
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided not to lift the legal immunity of Elisabetta Gualmini, an Italian member. Belgian prosecutors wanted to charge her with corruption and involvement in a criminal organisation, linked to the Qatargate investigation. Parliament found the evidence unclear and inconsistent, and saw signs that the case may be meant to damage her political work. So she keeps her protection from prosecution for now.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament refused the request, so Gualmini keeps her immunity.
- **Who it affects:** Elisabetta Gualmini and the Belgian prosecutors who wanted to charge her.
- **What happens next:** Parliament tells the Belgian authorities its decision. Prosecutors cannot pursue the case unless the immunity is waived later.
